senses.zh_definition: 维琪：英语使用中的女性名字，可作为 Victoria 的昵称或独立使用的名字。
senses.en_definition: A female given name, also used as a familiar form of Victoria.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang digunakan dalam bahasa Inggeris, termasuk sebagai nama panggilan bagi Victoria.
senses.nuances: 这是姓名用法，不是马来语中表示“胜利”的普通名词。输入没有说明具体人物；以下人物及对话均为教学示例。马来语释义为编辑释义，未获得输入所支持的 DBP 官方词条，故 status 为 unverified。姓名关系依据：[Ancestry：Vikki](https://www.ancestry.com/first-name-meaning/vikki?geo-lang=en)。搭配为说明性姓名组合，未验证语料频率。

etymology.historical_story: Vikki is used as a familiar form of Victoria and as a given name in its own right. Its association with Latin victory comes through Victoria; it does not make Vikki a Malay word meaning victory. A particular bearer may have a different naming story, so the spelling alone cannot establish that person’s original or legal name. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/first-name-meaning/vikki?geo-lang=en)
